sites.audience: independent practitioners, group practices, and behavioral health operations leaders
sites.heroComposition: asymmetric operational overview with a focused conversion panel
sites.typeCharacter: calm editorial authority with compact operational labels
sites.paletteFamily: warm ivory, deep ink, and restrained therapeutic green
sites.shapeGrammar: soft rectangular cards, fine rules, and ledger-inspired rows
sites.imageTreatment: documentary team imagery paired with service-specific workflow illustrations
sites.sectionRhythm: alternating editorial narratives, structured evidence bands, and practical workflow modules
sites.navigationTreatment: sticky compact header with exact task-oriented routes and visible parent-brand attribution
sites.motionSignature: restrained review marquee and subtle state transitions with reduced-motion support
sites.density: information-rich but scannable, with layered detail on service and editorial pages

designRead.statement: A calm administrative operations system that makes complex practice workflows visible and actionable.
designRead.primaryAccentStrategy: Use therapeutic green for decisions and calls to action, supported by warm neutral surfaces and dark editorial type.
designRead.shapeSystem: Rounded operational cards and ruled ledger modules organize information without decorative numbering.
designRead.typographyDirection: Editorial display headings pair with highly legible sans serif body copy and concise uppercase labels.
designRead.imageDirection: Use authentic Stealth Agents team photography and topic-specific workflow illustrations instead of generic clinical imagery.
designRead.motionRationale: Motion reinforces continuity and status while remaining restrained, optional, and respectful of reduced-motion preferences.
